_options.modality: image | sketch | text  (text only works with siglip)
_options.comparison_view: panorama (all 4 headings, matched one enlarged) | single (just the matched image)
_options.n_places: how many reference images (of the 20 test places) each participant rates; least-used are handed out first
_options.n_per_set: comparisons per reference: this many top results AND this many random images, 1-10 (10 = 10 + 10)
_options.n_repeats: consistency check: comparisons per reference shown a second time (0 = off; max depends on n_per_set)
_options.practice: true = start with a practice block (place p00: 2 top + 2 random, or fewer if n_per_set is 1)
_options.completion_url: Prolific's completion link (participants are sent there at the end)
_options.completion_code: Prolific's completion code (shown on the thank-you page)
